correspondingSourceStatus: The image repository pins exact executable bytes. The source commit that produced those binary bytes is not attested by that repository. Reference recipes describe the integration; they are not a bit-for-bit rebuild attestation. QEMU JS/Wasm, firmware, kernel and root image remain upstream downloads.
emulatorLicense: GPL-2.0, with separately licensed components; see QEMU-LICENSE.txt and QEMU-COPYING.txt
localLoaderLicense: MIT; complete upstream license header retained. Nonfunctional comment cleanup and deterministic browser bootstrap adaptation are recorded in localLoaderSource; full license in Emscripten-LICENSE.txt

runtime.rootMode: read-only base plus temporary writable overlay
runtime.checkpointExternalAttachments: Data volumes and evidence disks must be detached before a full VM checkpoint.
runtime.monitor: Private HMP pipe on the main loop; fixed serialized execution, register-observation and checkpoint commands

integration: Verified upstream module bytes are imported from a same-origin Blob URL; no arbitrary image-supplied JavaScript is accepted.

The browser worker and real-kernel Node tests share the same lifecycle dispatcher and engine. Node test bindings adapt only OS CPU enumeration and the WebSocket constructor; browser executable bytes remain unchanged.
Data-only package metadata is extracted from pinned preload scripts. Those preload scripts are not executed in the application.
A bounded concatenated newc archive overrides init to mount the root with a temporary overlay and remove exact upstream demo proxy/boot assumptions.
A private HMP pipe controls execution; the guest NIC is attached only to Terrarium NetworkPort.
Three additional private UART pipes provide independent interactive terminals while ttyS0 remains the agent control channel.

Two persistent raw VirtIO data disks use a bounded 64 KiB shared-memory mailbox. The emulator worker acknowledges each write only after the owning host VolumeSession transaction commits. Host and worker both enforce read-only attachments; cancellation wakes pending requests and teardown drains commits before releasing the volume locks.

Validated evidence archives become an independent read-only VirtIO disk. Both the QEMU device flag and the worker filesystem deny mutation; analyst mounting does not alter the source archive or its recorded checkpoint provenance.

Checkpoint capture attaches an application-generated private qcow2 state container only while guest CPUs are paused, uses QEMU savevm/loadvm and detaches it before execution resumes. Cold restore starts with -S and never sends guest input or cont before explicit resume.
The scoped, opt-in isolation service worker adds COOP/COEP to same-origin application documents and worker scripts without caching or external proxying.

localLoaderSource.change: Browser pthreads receive a bounded locateFile resolver before importing verified glue from a Blob URL. Only qemu-system-x86_64.wasm may resolve; instantiateWasm still uses the compiled module supplied by the parent. Node initialization is unchanged.
localLoaderSource.compatibility: This loader URL-resolution repair changes no guest CPU, RAM, devices, allocation or checkpoint serialization. The legacy checkpoint identifier is retained; actual runtime parity must still be validated.
localLoaderSource.commentCleanup: Removed a nonfunctional compiler TODO before applying the bounded browser URL hook; the MIT header is retained.
